attr.title: Castlevania: Harmony of Dissonance DS
attr.desc: Native static recompilation of Castlevania: Harmony of Dissonance (GBA) with a dual-screen interface: the game on top; castle map, status, settings and the game's own menus on the bottom touch screen.
attr.inst: Copy your Castlevania - Harmony of Dissonance (USA) ROM (.gba) and gba_bios.bin into ports/hod/.
